Your child will forget most of their toys. But they won't forget how your voice made them feel. 🔊

Hannah is six. She spills her juice and runs, because she knows what's coming. Mom yells. And yells again over every lost sock. 😣

By eight, something has changed. She hides the truth. Her confidence fades. 🪫

To a child, a parent's anger feels so much heavier than it does to us, and research links harsh yelling with more sadness and worry in kids. 💔

The Bible warns us: "Fathers, provoke not your children to anger, lest they be discouraged." Colossians 3:21

But look at how Jesus treats the hurting: "A bruised reed shall he not break." Matthew 12:20 🙏 He carried our anger and shame so we can be gentle with our little ones.

So kneel down. Say sorry. Start again. ❤️ At nine, Hannah drops a plate and doesn't run, because the voice you use today becomes the voice in their head tomorrow.

And remember: some quiet children aren't just shy. They're carrying worry. ❤️

BravePath Kids is a Christ-centered 21-day journey for childhood anxiety, made for parents and kids to do together:
✨ Simple anxiety skills
📖 Scripture they can hold onto
🙏 Prayer
❤️ Love in action
Ages 4-6, 7-9 and 10-12.
